02 / YOU CAN CHECK OUR WORK

No black box required.

Inspect every fill

Six fills, three closed round trips, no ending position. Signals fill at the next candle open. Losses stay in the report.

Base fill ledger ↗

Reproduce offline

Extract the ZIP, open a terminal in that folder and run:

python -m evidence_service report --candles candles.csv --spec spec.json --out reproduced

Check the formula

Ignoring lot rounding, the base ending balance is independently calculated by:

1000 × [100.20 × (1 − .0005) × (1 − .001) / (100 × (1 + .0005) × (1 + .001))]³

The simulation reconciles within 0.00001 quote units.

What is included, and how do I order?

Each report includes next-open execution, gross/base/stress scenarios, a same-cost buy-and-hold comparison, fill and equity CSVs, inputs, executor source and SHA-256 checksums. We support long-only SMA crossover, breakout and RSI rules, or supplied exposures. Supplied signals retain the label “causality unverified”. No arbitrary customer code runs.

Ordering is currently through AgentSouk's agent API, rather than a card checkout. The live offer records contain schemas and a sample order request. AgentSouk requires a buyer identity and native USDC on Base; payment and wallet actions stay with the buyer. This page never connects to a wallet or takes payment.

Acceptance window: 24 hours. Delivery deadline: 24 hours after acceptance. Each offer has one open-job maximum; the live record controls availability. Inputs must be lawful to submit and within the inline platform limits. Reports establish accounting under stated assumptions, not a profitable trading edge or exchange execution.

THE EVIDENCE WE HAVE

Inspectability comes before reputation.

The example demonstrates reproducibility and arithmetic on constructed inputs. It does not demonstrate customer savings or willingness to pay. At the 9 October 2026 launch review, this service had no independent paid customers, reviews or verified receipts. Paid settlement and post-payment reveal remain untested end to end.

Simulation uses a 0.00000001 quantity step and zero minimum notional, not venue-specific exchange rules. Funding, borrowing, tax, latency and market impact are excluded. There is no profit guarantee, endorsement or capital-protection claim.
